extensionName.description: ⚠️ MACHINE-TRANSLATED — needs native-speaker review. 'GeoSpoof' is a brand name; do not translate.

extensionDescription.message: 偽造瀏覽器的地理位置和時區，自動與 VPN 同步，並阻擋 WebRTC IP 洩漏。
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and store listing.

onboarding_step1_strong.description: Bolded lead-in for the first onboarding step.

onboarding_step1_text.message: 使用分頁搜尋城市，或手動輸入座標
onboarding_step1_text.description: Body text of the first onboarding step.

onboarding_step2_strong.description: Bolded lead-in for the second onboarding step.

onboarding_step2_text.description: Body text of the second onboarding step.

onboarding_step3_strong.description: Bolded lead-in for the third onboarding step.

onboarding_step3_text.message: 啟用 WebRTC 保護，進一步保護隱私
onboarding_step3_text.description: Body text of the third onboarding step.

onboarding_button.description: Button that closes the onboarding overlay.

status_disabled.description: Status pill shown when location protection is off.

status_enabled.description: Status pill shown when location protection is on.

tab_main.description: Tab label for the main popup view.

tab_details.description: Tab label for the protection details view.

tab_filters.description: Tab label for the Sites view (formerly 'Filters'): where GeoSpoof works, this site, and per-site locations. Also the back rows' label (‹ Sites). Use the locale's plain word for websites as a tab name; it shares a word with siteLocation_sitesLabel. The key keeps its old name.

tab_settings.description: Hover tooltip for the settings gear button in the popup header. It opens the settings view, which holds the controls that were previously behind the 'Advanced' accordion in the Details tab. Keep short — it is a tooltip on a small icon button.

tab_settings_ariaLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the settings gear button in the popup header. Phrased as an action ('Open settings') because the button has no visible text label, unlike the tooltip which is just the destination name.

settings_headingSitesSee.description: Settings screen: heading over the group of settings that change what websites receive (Location Accuracy, Location Precision, Preserve location prompts, Reported Language). Shown in capitals.

settings_headingAdvanced.description: Settings screen: heading over the browser-specific opt-in (Engine-level Spoofing on Chrome, Instant timezone protection on Firefox). Same word as advanced_button. Shown in capitals.

settings_headingGeneral.description: Settings screen: heading over the settings about the popup itself (Theme, Language, Debug Logging). Shown in capitals.

settings_proNote.message: 🔒 此區段的設定是 GeoSpoof Pro 功能。請在 GeoSpoof App 中升級。
settings_proNote.description: Shown under the WHAT SITES SEE heading for non-Pro iOS users, whose settings in that section are locked; every locked row is described by it. The second sentence is siteLocation_proNote's second sentence, word for word.

details_section_locale.description: Heading for the group of language/locale APIs listed under 'Key Overrides' in the Details tab. Shown only when a Reported Language is active.

filters_heading.description: Heading for the Sites view (tab_filters). Not shown in the popup today; kept equal to tab_filters.

filters_where.description: Section heading above the three mode segments (All sites, Allowlist, Denylist) on the Sites tab. Shown uppercase by the style. Names the radiogroup for screen readers. Formerly "Where GeoSpoof works".

filters_screenTitle.description: Title of the Filters screen (the mode and its list) and label of its row on the Sites tab root. The tab was called this before it became Sites (tab_filters); use the same word the tab used.

filters_siteRules.description: Section heading on the Sites tab root above the card with the Filters and Per-site locations rows, styled like filters_thisSite (shown uppercase). A short, natural phrase for rules about sites; must fit one line at 350 px.

filters_modeAll.description: Scope mode segment: GeoSpoof works on every site.

filters_modeAllowlist.description: Scope mode option: spoof only on listed sites.

filters_modeDenylist.description: Scope mode option: spoof on every site except listed ones.

filters_descAll.message: GeoSpoof 在所有網站上生效。
filters_descAll.description: Sentence under the scope-mode selector in All sites mode. Describes the setting, stated positively with 'works'; it doesn't change with the site.

filters_descAllow.message: GeoSpoof 僅在允許清單中的網站上生效。
filters_descAllow.description: Sentence under the scope-mode selector in Allowlist mode. 'Allowlist' is the list's name, as filters_allowlistName has it.

filters_descDeny.message: GeoSpoof 在除封鎖清單中網站以外的所有網站上生效。
filters_descDeny.description: Sentence under the scope-mode selector in Denylist mode. 'Denylist' is the list's name, as filters_denylistName has it.

filters_allowlistName.description: The Allowlist's name as a noun: the Filters root's row, the list screen's title, and inside sentences. The segment label is filters_modeAllowlist.

filters_denylistName.description: The Denylist's name as a noun: the Filters root's row, the list screen's title, and inside sentences. The segment label is filters_modeDenylist.

filters_countOnList.description: The list row's value on the Filters root. $COUNT$ is a formatted number of entries; one entry can be a site group of many sites, so this doesn't say 'sites'.

filters_listEmpty.description: The Denylist row's value on the Filters root when the Denylist is empty. A status value, not a sentence.

filters_listEmptyAllow.message: 空白 · 在所有網站上關閉
filters_listEmptyAllow.description: The Allowlist row's value on the Filters root when the Allowlist is empty, after a ⚠ drawn by the markup. A status value with one detail after the '·'.

filters_addSite.description: Green button on a list screen that adds the current tab's site, without www. The markup draws a ＋ before it. Also the first suggestion when the add field (list screens, per-site editor Sites field) is focused while empty. $SITE$ is the site.

filters_listed.description: On a list screen, after '✓ twitch.tv ·': the current tab's site is in this list. A status value.

filters_coveredBy.description: After '✓ twitch.tv ·' on a list screen, and as the This site card's reason: the list entry that covers the current tab's site. A phrase without a subject. $ENTRY$ is the entry as the list shows it, for example *.tv or Google.

filters_somePages.description: The This site card's reason when no list entry covers the current page but an entry covers some pages of the site (for example twitch.tv/videos/*). A phrase without a subject.

filters_thisSite.description: Heading above the This site card at the top of the Filters tab. Shown in capitals by the stylesheet.

filters_valueOff.description: The This site card's value when GeoSpoof is off on the current page (Location Protection off, or Filters keep it off). One word, like Safari's per-site values.

filters_valueNotSet.description: The This site card's value when GeoSpoof is on for the current page but no location is set (no main location and no per-site location).

filters_openMainAria.description: Screen-reader description of the This site card's "Set Location" button (filters_setLocation), which opens the Main tab. Names the Main tab as tab_main does.

filters_turnOnProtection.description: The This site card's button when Location Protection is off. Turns Location Protection on in place, as the Main tab's toggle does. Names the toggle as toggle_locationProtection does. Title-style capitalization in English, like the card's other buttons.

filters_setLocation.description: The This site card's button when no location is set. Switches to the Main tab and focuses the city search; its screen-reader description is filters_openMainAria. Title-style capitalization in English, like the card's other buttons.

filters_actionAria.description: Accessible name of the This site card's button and of the per-site editor's Filters button. $ACTION$ is the button's visible label, so the name starts with it; $SITE$ is the current site without www.

filters_removeFromAllowlist.description: Button on the This site card (and in the per-site editor's Filters hint) that removes the current site's own entry from the Allowlist. Uses filters_allowlistName's noun.

filters_addToDenylist.description: Button on the This site card (and in the per-site editor's Filters hint) that adds the current site to the Denylist. Uses filters_denylistName's noun.

filters_removeFromDenylist.description: Button on the This site card (and in the per-site editor's Filters hint) that removes the current site's own entry from the Denylist. Uses filters_denylistName's noun.

filters_statusAnnounce.description: Spoken by screen readers after a change on the Filters tab, never shown. $NAME$ is a site or a list name (twitch.tv, Allowlist); $VALUE$ its new value (Off, a place, or 'Empty, Off on every site').

filters_help.description: Collapsible help on a list screen: what can be added (sites, patterns, site groups, lists from a link). Replaces 'What patterns can I use?'.

filters_addButton.description: Button that adds the typed domain to the active list.

filters_fieldSiteOrGroup.message: 網站或網站群組，例如 twitch.tv
filters_fieldSiteOrGroup.description: Placeholder of the add field on the Allowlist and Denylist screens and of the Sites field in the per-site location editor, where site groups are available. Typing lists suggestions; focusing the empty field offers "Add <site>" and "Browse all site groups…". Keep twitch.tv untranslated. Use the same word for site group as siteGroups_browseAll.

filters_fieldSite.description: The same placeholder where site groups aren't available (Safari): names sites only. Keep twitch.tv untranslated.

filters_emptyList.description: Indicator shown when the active site list is empty.

filters_notSaved.description: Inline message shown when a scope change could not be saved.

filters_loadError.description: Inline message shown when the popup cannot load settings.

filters_removeAriaLabel.description: Accessible label prefix on a site's remove button.

filters_syntaxDomain.message: 該網站及其所有子網域
filters_syntaxDomain.description: Explains the bare-domain pattern form (e.g. example.com) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxSubdomains.message: 僅限子網域，不含 example.com 本身
filters_syntaxSubdomains.description: Explains the wildcard-subdomain pattern form (e.g. *.example.com), which excludes the apex, in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxTld.message: 任何以 .ru 結尾的網站
filters_syntaxTld.description: Explains the wildcard-TLD pattern form (e.g. *.ru) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxPort.description: Explains the host:port pattern form (e.g. localhost:3000) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxPath.message: 某個路徑及其下的所有內容
filters_syntaxPath.description: Explains the path pattern form (e.g. site.com/app/*) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxIdn.message: 也支援國際化網域名稱
filters_syntaxIdn.description: Explains that internationalized (non-ASCII) domain names are supported, in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxNotes.message: 只有 * 是萬用字元——不支援正規表示式。
filters_syntaxNotes.description: The short capability note at the bottom of the syntax reference.

siteLocation_syntaxSeveral.description: Per-site location editor, "What can I add?": explains typing several sites separated by commas (e.g. chatgpt.com, openai.com) in the Sites field.

siteLocation_syntaxNotes.message: 僅限整個網站，不能帶 /app 這類路徑。只有 * 是萬用字元。
siteLocation_syntaxNotes.description: Per-site location editor, "What can I add?": the note under the rows. A per-site location applies to whole sites, so the Sites field rejects paths (site.com/app/*) and a bare *. Keep /app and * as is.

filters_syntaxReference.description: Link at the bottom of the syntax reference that opens the full Site Filters documentation on GitHub.

toggle_locationProtection.description: Label for the toggle that enables location spoofing.

toggle_webrtcProtection.description: Label for the toggle that enables WebRTC IP leak protection.

toggle_preserveGeoPrompt.description: Label for the toggle that makes GeoSpoof show the browser's native geolocation permission prompt (and only substitute the spoofed location after the user allows) instead of silently auto-granting it to every site.

preserveGeoPrompt_infoAriaLabel.message: 關於「保留位置權限提示」的更多資訊
preserveGeoPrompt_infoAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the Preserve location prompts info icon.

preserveGeoPrompt_tooltip.message: 開啟時，在 GeoSpoof 已啟用的網站取得你的偽造位置之前，瀏覽器會先詢問。
preserveGeoPrompt_tooltip.description: Shown when the ⓘ next to Preserve location prompts is opened: when on, the browser's permission prompt appears before a site in spoofing scope receives the spoofed location.

heading_location.description: Section heading above the spoofed location display.

heading_protection.description: Section heading above the protection toggles in the Main tab.

location_none.description: Shown when no spoofed location has been configured.

location_custom.description: Shown above a manually entered (non-search) location.

location_clearTitle.description: Tooltip title on the clear-location button.

location_clearAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the clear-location button.

toggle_syncWithVpn.description: Label for the toggle that syncs location to the user's public IP.

vpnSync_infoAriaLabel.message: 關於「與 VPN 同步」的更多資訊
vpnSync_infoAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the VPN sync info icon.

vpnSync_tooltip.message: 將你的偽造位置同步為目前公用 IP 的位置。VPN 切換伺服器後，幾秒內就會自動更新；也可以使用「重新同步」立即更新。
vpnSync_tooltip.description: Tooltip explaining that VPN sync auto-updates when the VPN changes servers, with a manual Re-sync option.

vpnSync_syncNow.description: Button that performs an initial VPN sync.

vpnSync_resync.description: Button that performs a follow-up VPN sync.

vpnSync_detectedIp.description: Shown after a successful VPN sync. $IP$ is the detected public IP address.

vpnSync_networkError.message: 發生網路錯誤，請再試一次。
vpnSync_networkError.description: Error toast shown when the VPN sync network call fails.

inputTab_searchCity.description: Tab label for the city-search input mode.

inputTab_enterCoords.description: Tab label for the manual-coordinates input mode.

search_placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the city search input.

search_searching.description: Status shown while a city search is in flight.

search_noResults.description: Status shown when a city search returns no matches.

search_failed.description: Error toast shown when a city search request fails.

search_settingLocation.description: Status shown while a chosen location is being applied.

search_setLocationFailed.message: 無法設定位置，請再試一次。
search_setLocationFailed.description: Error toast shown when applying a chosen location fails.

coords_latPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the latitude input.

coords_lonPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the longitude input.

coords_setButton.description: Button that applies the manually entered coordinates.

coords_pasteHint.message: 提示：可貼上一組座標或 geohash
coords_pasteHint.description: Discovery hint under the coordinate inputs telling the user they can paste a lat/lon pair, DMS, or a geohash instead of typing.

coords_pasteFailed.message: 無法讀取座標，請改用一組座標或 geohash
coords_pasteFailed.description: Inline error shown under the coordinate inputs when a pasted string looked like a coordinate but could not be parsed.

coords_invalidLat.message: 緯度無效，必須介於 -90 到 90 之間。
coords_invalidLat.description: Validation error shown when latitude is out of range.

coords_invalidLon.message: 經度無效，必須介於 -180 到 180 之間。
coords_invalidLon.description: Validation error shown when longitude is out of range.

warning_noLocationSet.message: ⚠️ 已啟用保護，但尚未設定位置
warning_noLocationSet.description: Warning shown when protection is on but no location is configured.

warning_refreshPage.message: ⚠️ 重新整理此頁面以套用保護
warning_refreshPage.description: Warning shown when the active page must be reloaded for protection to apply.

notice_restrictedPage.message: ℹ️ 擴充功能無法在此頁面上執行
notice_restrictedPage.description: Notice shown on browser-internal pages where extensions cannot run.

testLinks_verify.description: Footer link to the hosted verification page that checks the user's protection.

support_needHelp.description: Footer link prompting the user to open the support page.

support_review.description: Footer link that opens a short modal asking the user to leave a store review.

iosPromo_text.message: 用 GeoSpoof 變更 iPhone 的真實 GPS
iosPromo_text.description: Footer cross-link to the GeoSpoof app on the App Store. Leads with what the app does - move the iPhone's real, system-level GPS - rather than with the product name, because the name alone does not say what you get. Names no desktop platform on purpose: the Mac and Windows companions are discovered on the store page, and leaving them out keeps the label on one line at the popup's 350px width.

vpnPromo_text.message: 搭配 Proton VPN 使用
vpnPromo_text.description: Footer cross-link inviting the user to pair GeoSpoof with Proton VPN (a disclosed affiliate recommendation); shown on non-Apple operating systems (Windows/Linux/Android/ChromeOS) in place of the Apple App Store link. Points at the on-site /vpn recommendation page.

vpnPromo_ariaLabel.message: 搭配 Proton VPN 使用（廣告）
vpnPromo_ariaLabel.description: Accessible label for the footer Proton VPN affiliate cross-link (the visible text sits next to a shield glyph).

vpnPromo_tag.description: Small inline marker disclosing that the adjacent Proton VPN link is an affiliate link.

review_modal_title.description: Heading of the modal that asks the user to leave a review.

review_modal_body1.message: GeoSpoof 用心打造：不追蹤、不需帳號。這是我利用自己的時間開發與維護的作品。
review_modal_body1.description: First paragraph of the review-request modal (desktop builds).

review_modal_body1_ios.message: GeoSpoof 用心打造：不追蹤、不需帳號。我利用自己的時間開發它，只為守護你的位置隱私。
review_modal_body1_ios.description: First paragraph of the review-request modal on iOS, where the app is freemium so it does not claim to be free.

review_modal_body2.message: 留下評論是支持它最好的方式。只要一分鐘，就能幫助更多人發現 GeoSpoof。非常感謝！
review_modal_body2.description: Second paragraph of the review-request modal.

review_modal_cta.description: Primary button in the review modal that opens the store review page.

review_modal_dismiss.description: Secondary button that dismisses the review modal.

webrtc_configFailed.message: 無法設定 WebRTC 保護，請檢查擴充功能權限。
webrtc_configFailed.description: Error toast shown when WebRTC protection cannot be configured.

details_spoofedLocation.description: Section title for the spoofed-location details.

details_spoofedTimezone.description: Section title for the spoofed-timezone details.

details_webrtcProtection.description: Section title for the WebRTC protection details.

details_overriddenApis.description: Section title for the list of overridden browser APIs.

details_notConfigured.description: Placeholder shown when a detail field has no value.

details_none.description: Shown when a detail field has no items.

details_noneDisabled.description: Shown when a detail field is empty because protection is off.

details_latitudeLabel.description: Label for the latitude row in the location details.

details_longitudeLabel.description: Label for the longitude row in the location details.

details_accuracyLabel.description: Label for the accuracy row in the location details.

details_locationLabel.description: Label for the location-name row in the location details.

details_identifierLabel.description: Label for the timezone-identifier row in the timezone details.

details_offsetLabel.description: Label for the UTC-offset row in the timezone details.

details_dstOffsetLabel.description: Label for the DST-offset row in the timezone details.

details_dstOffsetMinutes.description: Formatted DST offset in minutes. $MINUTES$ is the integer minute count.

details_fallbackNote.description: Inline note shown when timezone data is estimated rather than authoritative.

details_webrtcActiveStatus.description: Status label shown in the WebRTC details when protection is active.

details_webrtcInactiveStatus.description: Status label shown in the WebRTC details when protection is inactive.

details_webrtcInactiveNote.message: 即使使用 VPN，WebRTC 仍可能洩漏你的真實 IP 位址。
details_webrtcInactiveNote.description: Caption shown under the WebRTC status when protection is inactive.

details_section_geolocation.description: Header for the geolocation overrides section.

details_section_timezone.description: Header for the timezone overrides section.

details_section_webrtc.description: Header for the WebRTC overrides section.

details_section_dateTime.description: Header for the date/time overrides section.

details_section_temporal.description: Header for the Temporal API overrides section.

details_section_xslt.description: Header for the XSLT/EXSLT overrides section.

details_section_workers.description: Header for the worker timezone-propagation overrides section.

details_section_antiFingerprinting.description: Header for the anti-fingerprinting and structural overrides section.

details_keyOverrides.description: Title of the summary line above the grouped list of overridden APIs.

advanced_button.description: Button that opens the advanced-settings drawer.

advanced_earlyTz.description: Label for the Firefox-only toggle that grants the userScripts permission to spoof synchronous timezone surfaces from the very first script on a page.

earlyTz_infoAriaLabel.message: 關於「即時時區保護」的更多資訊
earlyTz_infoAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the Instant timezone protection info icon.

earlyTz_tooltip.message: 在頁面載入的最開始執行保護，讓網站讀取你真實時區的時間更少。會要求 Firefox 的「userScripts」權限。
earlyTz_tooltip.description: Shown when the ⓘ next to Instant timezone protection (Firefox only) is opened. Must stay within docs/API.md: it shortens the window before protection runs, it doesn't promise to close it on every load.

advanced_debuggerMode.description: Label for the Chrome-only toggle that spoofs the timezone in the browser engine (via the chrome.debugger API / Chrome DevTools Protocol) so it also covers background workers and cross-site frames, applied as early as Chrome allows.

debuggerMode_infoAriaLabel.message: 關於「引擎層級偽造」的更多資訊
debuggerMode_infoAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the Engine-level Spoofing info icon.

debuggerMode_tooltip.message: 同時在 Chrome 引擎中設定你的時區，比標準保護涵蓋頁面中更多的 Worker 和框架。開啟時，Chrome 會顯示偵錯資訊列。
debuggerMode_tooltip.description: Shown when the ⓘ next to Engine-level Spoofing (Chrome only) is opened. Must stay within docs/API.md: it reaches more workers and frames than standard protection, not all of them.

debuggerBannerHelp_text.message: 開啟時，Chrome 會顯示「『GeoSpoof』已開始為這個瀏覽器偵錯」資訊列。如要隱藏，請使用以下旗標啟動 Chrome：
debuggerBannerHelp_text.description: Intro text of the dismissible note shown when Engine-level Spoofing is enabled, explaining how to hide Chrome's debugging notification bar.

debuggerBannerHelp_link.description: Link to the GeoSpoof help page explaining how to hide Chrome's debugging notification bar.

debuggerBannerHelp_closeAria.description: Accessible label for the button that dismisses the debugging-bar help note.

advanced_verbosity_warn.description: Verbosity level: error and warning logs.

advanced_verbosity_debug.description: Verbosity level: info and debug logs.

advanced_verbosity_trace.description: Verbosity level: full trace including per-call logs.

advanced_theme.description: Label for the popup theme selector.

advanced_theme_system.description: Theme option that follows the OS appearance.

advanced_theme_light.description: Theme option that forces the light popup theme.

advanced_theme_dark.description: Theme option that forces the dark popup theme.

advanced_accuracy.description: Label for the accuracy selector that controls how the spoofed GeolocationCoordinates.accuracy value is produced.

advanced_accuracy_realistic.description: Accuracy option that picks a device-appropriate value automatically (auto mode).

advanced_accuracy_custom.description: Accuracy option that reveals a numeric input for an exact meter value (fixed mode).

advanced_accuracy_customHint.message: 請輸入 1 到 10000 公尺之間的值
advanced_accuracy_customHint.description: Inline hint shown when the custom accuracy value is out of the allowed range.

advanced_accuracy_customSet.description: Button that commits the typed custom accuracy value (fixed mode). The custom value is applied only when this button is clicked or Enter is pressed.

advanced_accuracy_meters.description: Visible label of the number field shown under Location Accuracy when Custom is selected; the field holds the accuracy in meters.

randomize_title.description: Settings row label, and the title of the screen it opens, for the feature that reports a random point near the chosen location instead of the location itself (replaces 'Location Precision'). Keep it short: it shares a 350px row with a value such as '2 km · Hourly'.

randomize_headingDistance.description: Section heading on the Randomize location screen, above the list of distances (Off, Within 0.5 km, Within 2 km, Within 10 km).

randomize_headingNewPoint.description: Section heading on the Randomize location screen, above the 'Pick a new point' picker. Use the same words for 'new point' as advanced_precisionCadence.

randomize_distance_exact.description: Distance option: no randomizing, sites get the exact chosen location (default). Use the same word for 'Off' as randomize_value_off.

randomize_distance_street.description: Distance option: a random point within half a kilometer of the chosen location. Write the distance as randomize_value_street does.

randomize_distance_neighborhood.description: Distance option: a random point within two kilometers of the chosen location. Write the distance as randomize_value_neighborhood does.

randomize_distance_city.description: Distance option: a random point within ten kilometers of the chosen location. Write the distance as randomize_value_city does.

randomize_value_off.description: Value shown on the Settings row 'Randomize location' when Distance is Off. Short.

randomize_value_street.description: Value shown on the Settings row 'Randomize location' for Within 0.5 km: the distance alone, in local number format.

randomize_value_neighborhood.description: Value shown on the Settings row 'Randomize location' for Within 2 km: the distance alone.

randomize_value_city.description: Value shown on the Settings row 'Randomize location' for Within 10 km: the distance alone.

randomize_value_session.description: Short form of advanced_precisionCadence_session, shown after the distance on the Settings row ('2 km · Each session').

randomize_value_hour.description: Short form of advanced_precisionCadence_hour, shown after the distance on the Settings row ('2 km · Hourly').

randomize_value_day.description: Short form of advanced_precisionCadence_day, shown after the distance on the Settings row ('2 km · Daily').

randomize_caption.message: 網站看到的是你所選位置周圍此距離內的一個隨機地點。新地點在多次造訪之間更難被辨識，但也讓網站有更多樣本可以取平均。
randomize_caption.description: Caption at the bottom of the Randomize location screen. The random point is around the location the user chose in GeoSpoof, never their real location. Second sentence: the trade-off of 'Pick a new point' (a changing point is harder to recognize across visits, but a site that collects several can average them).

advanced_precisionCadence.description: Label for the dropdown setting how often Approximate location picks a new random point in the same radius.

advanced_precisionCadence_never.description: Default. Keep the same point until the location or precision changes.

advanced_precisionCadence_session.description: A new point each time the browser starts.

advanced_precisionCadence_hour.description: A new point about once an hour. Open pages move too.

advanced_precisionCadence_day.description: A new point about once a day. Open pages move too.

advanced_coffee.description: Footer link inviting the user to buy the maintainer a coffee.

advanced_language.description: Label for the popup UI language selector in Advanced settings.

advanced_language_system.description: Language selector option that follows the browser's UI language instead of a fixed choice.

advanced_locale.description: Label for the control that sets the language websites see (navigator.language, Intl formats, and the Accept-Language header). Deliberately distinct from 'Language', which sets GeoSpoof's own popup language.

advanced_locale_off.description: Reported Language option that leaves the browser's real language untouched (the default).

advanced_locale_match.description: Reported Language option that derives the language automatically from the spoofed location.

advanced_locale_custom.description: Reported Language option that reveals a text input for picking a specific language tag.

advanced_locale_customTag.description: Accessible label for the text input where a BCP47 language tag such as fr-FR is entered.

advanced_locale_customSet.description: Button that commits the typed language tag. The value is applied only when this button is clicked or Enter is pressed.

advanced_locale_customHint.message: 請輸入瀏覽器支援的語言標籤，例如 fr-FR 或 ja
advanced_locale_customHint.description: Inline hint shown when the entered language tag is malformed or unsupported by the browser, so it was not applied.

advanced_locale_warning.message: ⚠️ 許多網站會切換成這個語言，而且每次請求都會傳送它。
advanced_locale_warning.description: Caution shown while a reported language is active, explaining that sites will visibly change language and that the choice is also sent as an HTTP header.

advanced_locale_hint.message: 設定網站看到的語言，以及日期與數字格式。
advanced_locale_hint.description: Caption under the Reported Language card describing what it changes, in plain words.

siteLocation_statusSite.description: Compact line on the Main tab, shown only when a site location applies to the current tab. $SITE$ is the site's host name without a leading www., $PLACE$ the site location's name.

siteLocation_useMain.description: Text button on the Main-tab site location line that stops using the site location for the current site, so it uses the main (global) location again. 'Main location' is the glossary term for the global location.

siteLocation_addToAllowlist.description: Button on the This site card (and in the per-site editor's Filters hint) that adds the current site to the Allowlist. Uses filters_allowlistName's noun.

siteLocation_hintVpn.message: 網站仍會看到你的 VPN 的 IP 位址。在此使用不同的位置可能會顯得不一致。
siteLocation_hintVpn.description: Hint shown with Sync with VPN on, in the site location editor and under the Main-tab site location line, explaining that a site location doesn't change the IP address sites see.

siteLocation_reloadHint.message: 請重新載入受影響的頁面以套用變更。
siteLocation_reloadHint.description: Hint shown right after a site location change made from the popup, because already-open pages keep their old values until reloaded.

siteLocation_sitesLabel.description: Label of the site location editor's text field listing the sites the location applies to.

siteLocation_searchLabel.description: Label of the site location editor's location search field.

siteLocation_favorites.description: Heading above the user's saved favorites, listed as suggestions under the Location field of the per-site location editor.

siteLocation_explain.description: Plain-language summary in the site location editor. $SITES$ is the comma-separated site list, $PLACE$ the chosen location.

siteLocation_save.description: Button that saves the site location in the editor.

siteLocation_cancel.description: Button that closes the site location editor without saving.

siteLocation_errorPattern.message: 請使用類似 example.com 的網站，不含路徑，也不能只是 *。
siteLocation_errorPattern.description: Error when a site in the Sites field isn't a valid site location pattern (paths and a bare * aren't allowed).

siteLocation_errorPatternLink.message: 請使用類似 example.com 的網站，不含路徑，也不能只是 *。如果是來自連結的清單，請以 list: 開頭。
siteLocation_errorPatternLink.description: Error when a site in the Sites field is an https link with a path, where lists from a link are available: the per-site pattern error plus how to add the link as a list. Keep example.com, *, and list: as is.

siteLocation_errorInUse.description: Error when a site already belongs to another entry in Per-site locations. $SITE$ is the site, $PLACE$ the name of the location it already uses.

siteLocation_editOwner.description: Button next to the siteLocation_errorInUse error that opens the other entry for editing.

siteLocation_errorCapacity.message: 這裡最多可以有 $MAX$ 個位置，請先移除一個。
siteLocation_errorCapacity.description: Error when Per-site locations already holds the maximum number of entries. $MAX$ is the limit. 'here' means this list; avoid wording that reads as a limit per site.

siteLocation_errorTooManySites.message: 一個位置最多可涵蓋 $MAX$ 個網站。
siteLocation_errorTooManySites.description: Error when too many sites are listed for one location in Per-site locations. $MAX$ is the limit.

siteLocation_errorTimezone.message: 無法查詢此地點的時區。請檢查網路連線後重試。
siteLocation_errorTimezone.description: Error when the time zone of the chosen place couldn't be determined, so the site location wasn't saved.

siteLocation_errorNoLocation.description: Error when saving a site location before picking a location.

siteLocation_sectionTitle.description: The Filters root's row and the title of the Per-site locations screen. 'Per-site locations' is the feature's glossary name: each site can have its own location. Keep it short, with no 'optional'.

siteLocation_sectionDesc.message: 在特定網站上使用不同的位置。
siteLocation_sectionDesc.description: Caption under the Per-site locations screen's title on the Filters tab.

siteLocation_add.description: Green button on the Per-site locations screen that opens the editor for a new entry with no site filled in (when the current tab's site already has one, or there's no site). The markup draws a ＋ before it. Worded so it can't be read as adding a filter.

siteLocation_setForSite.description: Green button on the Per-site locations screen when the current tab's site has no entry of its own; opens the editor with the site filled in. The markup draws a ＋ before it. $SITE$ is the site without www.

siteLocation_newLocation.description: Title of the per-site editor screen for a new entry.

siteLocation_srcSite.description: Title of the per-site editor screen for an existing entry; also names where a site's place comes from. Glossary term, paired with 'Main location'.

siteLocation_srcMain.description: Under the site on the This site card: the place shown comes from the main location. Glossary term, paired with 'Per-site location'.

siteLocation_srcEntry.description: Under the site on the This site card: the place comes from a per-site location through an entry that isn't the site's own. $ENTRY$ is that entry as its list row shows it, for example Google or *.google.com.

siteLocation_useHereAria.message: 在 $SITE$ 上使用其他位置
siteLocation_useHereAria.description: Screen-reader description of the This site card's row when the main location applies; opening it starts a new per-site location for $SITE$, the current site without www.

siteLocation_changeAria.description: Screen-reader description of a row on the Per-site locations screen, which opens the editor. $SITE$ is the row's site or sites.

siteLocation_countLocations.description: The Per-site locations row's value on the Filters root, for 2 or more entries. $COUNT$ is a formatted number.

siteLocation_countLocationsOne.description: The Per-site locations row's value with exactly one entry (WebExtension i18n has no plural forms).

siteLocation_noLocations.description: The Per-site locations row's value on the Filters root with no entries. A status value.

siteLocation_notUsed.message: 未使用 · 已在「網站」中關閉
siteLocation_notUsed.description: Mark under a one-site entry on the Per-site locations screen, after a ⚠ drawn by the markup: the Sites tab's settings keep GeoSpoof off there, so its location isn't used. 'Sites' is the tab's name (tab_filters), inflected as the grammar needs and written the way the locale writes a UI element's name.

siteLocation_notUsedOn.message: 在 $SITES$ 上未使用 · 已在「網站」中關閉
siteLocation_notUsedOn.description: As siteLocation_notUsed, for an entry with several sites, naming the ones Filters keep off. $SITES$ is up to two sites, or two and 'and N more' (siteLocation_sitesAndMore).

siteLocation_somePages.description: Mark under a one-site entry on the Per-site locations screen, after a ⚠ drawn by the markup: Filters cover only some pages of the site.

siteLocation_somePagesOn.message: 僅在 $SITES$ 的部分頁面上使用
siteLocation_somePagesOn.description: As siteLocation_somePages, for an entry with several sites. $SITES$ names the sites as in siteLocation_notUsedOn.

siteLocation_sitesAndMore.description: Names more than two sites in a mark: the first two, then how many more. $SITES$ is the first two joined by ', ', $COUNT$ a formatted number.

siteLocation_edit.description: Button on a site location row on the Filters tab, and on the Main-tab site location line, that opens the site location for editing.

siteLocation_editAriaLabel.description: Accessible label prefix on the edit button of an entry in Per-site locations; the location's name follows (e.g. 'Edit location Dublin'), as with filters_removeAriaLabel.

siteLocation_removeAriaLabel.description: Accessible label prefix on the remove button of an entry in Per-site locations; the location's name follows (e.g. 'Remove location Dublin'), as with filters_removeAriaLabel.

siteLocation_listAriaLabel.description: Accessible label of the Per-site locations list on the Filters tab. Same text as siteLocation_sectionTitle.

siteLocation_proNote.message: 🔒 允許清單、封鎖清單和網站專屬位置是 GeoSpoof Pro 功能。請在 GeoSpoof App 中升級。
siteLocation_proNote.description: Shown on the Filters tab in place of the mode sentence for non-Pro iOS users, whose Allowlist, Denylist and per-site location controls are locked; the locked Per-site locations row is described by it. Must contain siteLocation_sectionTitle's words.

details_siteLocation.description: Details tab heading for the location Per-site locations applies to the current tab; the value names the place, the site, and the time zone. Shown only when one applies.

badge_titleSiteLocation.description: Toolbar button tooltip when a site location applies to the current tab. $PLACE$ is the site location's name, $SITE$ the host name.

filters_typeSite.description: Second line of an add-field suggestion: the typed text as a site pattern such as example.com, which covers the site and all its subdomains.

filters_typeExact.description: Second line of an add-field suggestion: the typed host matches only itself, not its subdomains. Also shown under an exact-address entry in the list.

filters_typeSubdomains.description: Second line of an add-field suggestion: the typed site's subdomains, not the site itself (stored as *.example.com).

filters_typeGroup.description: Second line of an add-field suggestion for a site group, a named list of a service's sites (for example all of Google's sites), before its size. Glossary term shared with the GeoSpoof app.

filters_typeLink.description: Second line of the add-field suggestion for a pasted link: download a list of sites from an https link (a .txt, .list, .conf or .yaml file). Glossary term shared with the GeoSpoof app.

filters_errorExact.message: 請輸入一個位址，例如 mail.example.com，不要使用 *
filters_errorExact.description: Inline error when the text typed as an exact address isn't a single host (for example it contains a * wildcard).

filters_errorSiteOrGroup.message: 請使用類似 example.com 的網站，或在下方選擇一個網站群組。
filters_errorSiteOrGroup.description: Error under the Filters add field when the typed text isn't a site (for example 'google'). The matching site groups stay listed below it to pick. Keep example.com unchanged.

filters_errorSite.message: 請使用類似 example.com 的網站。
filters_errorSite.description: Error under the Filters add field when the typed text isn't a site, where site groups aren't available (Safari). Keep example.com unchanged.

filters_syntaxExact.message: 僅限該確切位址，不含其子網域
filters_syntaxExact.description: Explains the exact-address form (e.g. =mail.example.com) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxGroup.message: 網站群組：Google 的所有網站
filters_syntaxGroup.description: Explains the site group form (e.g. geosite:google) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxGroupTag.message: 僅限群組中帶有該標籤的網站
filters_syntaxGroupTag.description: Explains a site group with a tag (e.g. geosite:google@cn) in the syntax reference: only the group's sites that carry the tag.

filters_syntaxLink.message: 來自連結的清單，每週更新
filters_syntaxLink.description: Explains the list-from-a-link form (an https link to a list file) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxListPrefix.message: 指向網域清單的其他任何連結
filters_syntaxListPrefix.description: Explains the list: prefix form (list:https://… in front of any link) in the syntax reference: a list from a link whose address doesn't end in .txt, .list, .conf, .yaml or .yml. Keep list: and https://… as is.

siteGroups_popular.description: Heading of the first section in the site group picker: commonly used services.

siteGroups_allGroups.description: Heading of the second section in the site group picker: every other site group.

siteGroups_browseAll.description: Last row of the add field's suggestions. Opens the full list of site groups (Popular, then All site groups); the ellipsis says it shows more choices.

siteGroups_noMatch.message: 沒有符合 $QUERY$ 的網站群組
siteGroups_noMatch.description: Shown in the site group picker when the search finds nothing. $QUERY$ is what the user typed.

siteGroups_listboxLabel.description: Accessible name of the site group picker's list of choices.

siteGroups_attribution.message: 網站群組來自 v2fly 網域清單（MIT 授權）。
siteGroups_attribution.description: Footer of the site group picker crediting the data source. 'v2fly' is a project name; keep it.

siteGroups_count.description: How many sites a site group or list holds, under its name. $COUNT$ is a formatted number.

siteGroups_countOne.description: siteGroups_count when the site group or list holds exactly one site.

siteGroups_fromHost.description: Under a list from a link: where the list is downloaded from. $HOST$ is the link's host name.

siteGroups_skipped.description: Under a site group or list: how many of its rules GeoSpoof can't use (regular expressions and keywords). $COUNT$ is a formatted number.

siteGroups_skippedOne.description: siteGroups_skipped when exactly one rule is skipped.

siteGroups_unavailable.description: Under a site group or list whose data isn't on this device yet; it matches no sites until GeoSpoof downloads or rebuilds it.

siteGroups_linkFailed.description: Under a list from a link whose last update failed; the last good copy is still used.

siteGroups_statusFrom.description: Status line under the Filters list: the date of the site group data in use. $DATE$ is a formatted date.

siteGroups_statusFailed.message: 無法更新網站群組。正在使用 $DATE$ 的清單。
siteGroups_statusFailed.description: Status line when the last site group update failed; the older data stays in use. $DATE$ is its formatted date.

siteGroups_statusUpdating.description: Status line while site group data is being updated.

siteGroups_statusUpToDate.message: 網站群組已是最新（清單日期：$DATE$）
siteGroups_statusUpToDate.description: Status line after 'Update now' found no newer site group data. $DATE$ is the formatted date of the data in use.

siteGroups_updateNow.description: Button next to the site group status line that checks for newer site group data and lists right away.

siteGroups_errorUnknown.message: 沒有名為 $NAME$ 的網站群組。
siteGroups_errorUnknown.description: Error when adding a site group name that doesn't exist. $NAME$ is the name as typed.

siteGroups_errorEmpty.message: $NAME$ 中沒有帶該標籤的網站。
siteGroups_errorEmpty.description: Error when a site group with a tag (geosite:name@tag) leaves no sites. $NAME$ is the group's name.

siteGroups_errorLinkInvalid.message: 請輸入以 https:// 開頭的連結
siteGroups_errorLinkInvalid.description: Error when the text typed as a list from a link isn't an https link.

siteGroups_errorLinkFailed.message: 無法下載該清單。請檢查連結後重試。
siteGroups_errorLinkFailed.description: Error when the list at a link couldn't be downloaded. Nothing is added.

siteGroups_errorLinkEmpty.message: 該清單中沒有 GeoSpoof 可用的網站。
siteGroups_errorLinkEmpty.description: Error when a downloaded list holds no usable sites (for example only regular expressions). Nothing is added.

siteGroups_errorLinkTooLarge.message: 該清單太大。GeoSpoof 每個清單最多支援 $MAX$ 個網站。
siteGroups_errorLinkTooLarge.description: Error when a downloaded list is over the size limit. $MAX$ is the formatted limit. Nothing is added.

siteGroups_errorStorageFull.message: 網站群組的儲存空間已滿。請先移除一個較大的清單。
siteGroups_errorStorageFull.description: Error when the stored site group data would pass its storage limit. Nothing is added.

siteGroups_downloading.description: Shown on the Add button while a list from a link downloads; the add box is disabled meanwhile.

siteGroups_addedLink.description: Screen reader confirmation after a list from a link is added. $NAME$ is the list's name (from its file name). $SITES$ is siteGroups_count or siteGroups_countOne, already translated.

siteGroups_addedLinkSkipped.description: Screen reader confirmation after a list from a link is added and some of its rules can't be used. $NAME$ is the list's name. $SITES$ is siteGroups_count or siteGroups_countOne, and $SKIPPED$ is siteGroups_skipped or siteGroups_skippedOne, both already translated.

siteGroups_nameAi.description: Name of the featured site group of AI services (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and similar).

siteGroups_nameChina.description: Name of the featured site group of sites based in China. Glossary term shared with the GeoSpoof app.

siteGroups_nameOutsideChina.description: Name of the featured site group of sites not based in China. Glossary term shared with the GeoSpoof app.
